items.originalTitle: 'Not many sports teams have done it' - Wolff 'proud' of Mercedes turnaround
items.summaryEn: Mercedes clinched the 2026 Formula 1 Constructors' Championship with three races to spare at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, the team's ninth constructors' title. Toto Wolff said he is "proud" of Mercedes' turnaround and feels very few sports teams have bounced back so quickly.
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫在圣保罗大奖赛锁定2026赛季F1车队总冠军后，为梅赛德斯的逆转感到“自豪”。
梅赛德斯在2026赛季还剩三站时赢得队史第九个F1车队总冠军；梅赛德斯曾在2014至2021年间连续八次夺冠，此后经历了一段低谷期，托托·沃尔夫对银箭车队的反弹方式尤为自豪。
梅赛德斯在锁定第九个车队总冠军后于领奖台庆祝。
托托·沃尔夫表示，他为梅赛德斯逆转夺得2026赛季F1车队总冠军感到“自豪”，并认为很少有体育队伍能这么快完成反弹。
梅赛德斯在周日的圣保罗大奖赛上赢得了他们的第九个车队总冠军，距离他们上一次夺冠已经过去五年，当时那是他们连续第八个车队冠军。
2022年的规则变更终结了梅赛德斯的统治地位，他们难以驾驭所谓的“地面效应”赛车，但他们赢得了2026年新规赛车的首个赛季，并且本月早些时候还凭借基米·安东内利锁定了车手总冠军。

沃尔夫表示：“问题是，当你身处这些艰难时刻——就像我们每个人在生活中有时也会经历的那样——坚持下去并不容易。”
“事后回想起来，你会说：‘我们需要这些艰难时刻，才能作为个人成长，或者作为组织成长。’但当你身处低谷时，很难有这种感觉。
“我觉得过去这四年非常艰难，先是做错了，然后多少明白为什么错了，接着又意识到不，我们其实没搞懂。那段时间有点反反复复。
“但十年或二十年后我们会回望。当你看看统计数据，那四年里我们并不是彻底的输家，因为我们拿了第二、（第二）、第三、第四（在年度积分榜上），我们赢过分站，赢过很多分站。所以单看数字，根本没那么糟，但感觉并不好。”
托托·沃尔夫对梅赛德斯在巴西赢得车队总冠军作出回应
正如沃尔夫所指出的，梅赛德斯在2022年至2025年间仍然赢下了比赛，乔治·拉塞尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿两人合计赢得七场大奖赛。
“车队的韧性，以及那些在艰难时期团结在一起的人们，我认为是一个因素，”沃尔夫继续说道。
“锁定这两个冠军的感觉真的很好。没有多少体育团队能在连续夺冠之后经历一段困难时期、然后再度回归并做到这一点，所以我非常自豪我们属于在所有体育项目中做到这一点的极少数团队之一。”
2026年圣保罗大奖赛精彩集锦
梅赛德斯在车队总冠军数量上追平威廉姆斯，同为九次夺冠——在F1历史上，只有迈凯伦（10次）和法拉利（16次）比他们更多。
沃尔夫表示，他的自豪感源于梅赛德斯位于英国布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的工厂所付出的辛勤努力，这些努力让车队在本赛季平均而言打造出了最好的赛车。
“有时候，车手们或者我自己，会因为出现在电视镜头前而备受关注，但有太多人参与其中，”他告诉天空体育F1频道。
“我总是说，明星车手并不是只有两位，而是有2500位明星，他们都在出色地完成工作，我们所有人共同为这样一个锦标赛贡献力量。”
基米·安东内利回应梅赛德斯夺得第九个世界车队冠军
在巴西，梅赛德斯两位车手都未能登上领奖台，兰多·诺里斯在混合条件下占据统治地位，而安东内利和拉塞尔都发生了打转。
拉塞尔获得第四名，紧随其后的是安东内利，他表示梅赛德斯的每个人都“配得上”今年的成功。
这位意大利车手告诉天空体育F1：“他们这一年做得非常出色，这是一群了不起的人，每天都在全力以赴，为我们争取胜利和冠军提供最好的机会。”
“今年他们干得非常棒，正因如此他们配得上这个冠军，我们会一起享受这一刻。”
乔治·拉塞尔表示，在两辆赛车分别以第四和第五名完赛后，梅赛德斯本希望能以更风光的方式赢得车队总冠军。
拉塞尔补充道：“我们完成了来这里的目标，赢得了车队总冠军。我们本希望能更有风采一些，但对车队每个人来说这都是了不起的成就。”
“我们经历了艰难的四年，整个组织付出了巨大努力，才让我们回到这个位置。2022年我加入梅赛德斯时，我们曾希望自己能经常为冠军而战，所以走过这段旅程、如今重返巅峰，是我们所有人都应该无比自豪的事情。”

detailEn: Toto Wolff 'proud' of Mercedes turnaround after winning F1 2026 Constructors' Championship at Sao Paulo Grand Prix

Mercedes won their ninth F1 Constructors' Championship with three races to spare of the 2026 season; Mercedes won eight in a row between 2014 and 2021 before a fallow period and Toto Wolff is particularly proud of how the Silver Arrows bounced back
Mercedes party on the podium after sealing their ninth Constructors' Championship title
Toto Wolff says he's "proud" of Mercedes' turnaround to win the 2026 Formula 1 Constructors' Championship and feels very few sports teams have bounced back so quickly.
Mercedes won their ninth constructors' title on Sunday at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, five years after their last championship, which was their eighth in a row at the time.

Regulation changes in 2022 ended Mercedes' dominance as they struggled to get on top of the so-called ground effect cars, but they have won the first season of the new 2026 cars, and also wrapped up the Drivers' Championship earlier this month with Kimi Antonelli.

"The thing is when you are in these difficult moments, like we all are sometimes in our lives, it's not that easy to keep going," said Wolff.
"Looking back in retrospect, you're saying, 'we needed these tough moments in order to grow as people or to grow as an organisation'. But when you're down, that is quite difficult to feel.
"I think those last four years were very difficult between getting it wrong, then kind of understanding why it was wrong and then realising no we didn't understand. That was a bit back and forth.

"But we will be looking back in 10 or 20 years. When you look at the statistics, it wasn't that we were complete losers over those four years, because we finished second, (second), third, fourth [in the championship], we won races, won many races. So it wasn't that bad at all when you look at the sheer numbers, but it felt not good."
Toto Wolff reacts to Mercedes winning the Constructors' Championship in Brazil
As Wolff points out, Mercedes still won races between 2022 and 2025, with George Russell and Lewis Hamilton winning seven Grands Prix between them.
"The resilience of the team, the people that held together in those tough times, is a factor, I think," continued Wolff.

"It feels really good sealing those two titles. Not many sports teams have done that after consecutive run of championships, then a difficult spell and then coming back, so I'm really proud that we are part of this very small group of teams that have done that in all sports."
Highlights from the 2026 Sao Paulo Grand Prix
Mercedes move level with Williams on nine constructors' titles - only McLaren (10) and Ferrari (16) have more in Formula 1 history.
Wolff says his pride comes from the hard work in Mercedes' UK factories in Brackley and Brixworth to produce the best car, on average, this season.
"Sometimes the drivers, or myself, we are so visible because we are in in front of the TV cameras, but there's so many people that are part of this," he told Sky Sports F1.
"I always say there are not two superstars, the drivers, but there are 2,500 superstars, all of them delivering a great job, being all of us contributing to such a championship."
Kimi Antonelli reacts to Mercedes claiming their ninth world constructors championship
Mercedes were unable to finish with either of their drivers on the podium in Brazil as Lando Norris dominated in mixed conditions, while Antonelli and Russell both spun.
Russell finished in fourth, just ahead of Antonelli who says everyone at Mercedes "deserves" this year's success.

"They have done an incredible year and it's an amazing group of people, who push every day to do their best and give us the best opportunity to fight for wins and championships," the Italian told Sky Sports F1.
"This year they have done an incredible job and that's why they deserve this championship and we will enjoy it together."
George Russell says Mercedes would've liked to win the Constructors' Championship title in style after both cars finished fourth and fifth respectively

Russell added: "We achieved what we came here to do and won the Constructors' Championship. We would have liked to have done it in a bit more style, but it's an incredible achievement for everyone in the team.

"We've had four difficult years and the whole organisation put so much work into getting us back into this position. When I joined Mercedes in 2022, we hoped we'd be fighting for championships regularly, so to have gone through that journey and now get back to the top is something we should all be incredibly proud of."

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿：法拉利车手表示，由于在圣保罗大奖赛期间下雨时信息不足，他无视了车队的维修区指令
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在圣保罗大奖赛中排名第9，法拉利在巴西度过了一个令人失望的周末；汉密尔顿在比赛中后期因忽视换上中间胎的维修区指令而失去了位置，因为雨势加大
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在进入维修区前，在湿地轮胎上差点发生事故
刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示，由于信息不足，导致他在圣保罗大奖赛最后阶段下雨时无视了法拉利的维修区指令。
汉密尔顿在圣保罗赛道以第八名的成绩在比赛还剩10圈时开始下起大雨。当雨势加大时，领跑者们已经通过了维修区入口，但梅赛德斯车队将乔治·拉塞尔从第五位召回维修区。
法拉利指示汉密尔顿进站，但他决定与当时在他前面的小红牛车队李·劳森的赛车相反操作。紧随其后的队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔进入了维修区。

世界冠军在下一圈危险的条件下打转，并在那一圈结束时进入维修区，以跟随他的对手们换上中间胎。
2026年圣保罗大奖赛的精彩瞬间。
尽管没有太多悬念，因为汉密尔顿最终排名第9，而不是像他超越劳森本可能做到的第7名，但这却是英国车手和他的意大利车队不完美执行的最新例证。
在比赛后接受天空体育意大利的采访时，汉密尔顿表示："我得到的最后一条信息是雨会保持同样的强度，在这样的条件下，我的抓地力感觉相当不错。"
“我就像，啊，我追上了。’我正从最后一个弯道出来，就在维修区入口之前，他们让我进站，我就在劳森后面。
在一场令人失望的比赛中，刘易斯·汉密尔顿反思了‘艰难’的圣保罗大奖赛。
“他进站了，而我最终留在了（赛道上）。他们没有说第一圈的一半是在下雨。如果我知道的话，我会进站的。
“我一到第一个弯道，就意识到路面是湿的。所以，那里信息有点不足。”
“最终，这是我的责任。我为车队感到抱歉，为此我尽了全力。但遗憾的是，我们今天没有速度。”
汉密尔顿在上周末的墨西哥大奖赛上与队友发生了重大争议，因为他愤怒于两人之间的第一圈碰撞，他认为这让他失去了胜利，也让车队失去了包揽冠亚的机会。
尽管汉密尔顿在周六表示两人已经“解决了”他们的问题，但他们在巴西的挣扎凸显了他们在墨西哥城的胜利机会是多么宝贵。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔在两位车手之间发生公开争执后回答了有关刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题。
汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔都受到了发车罚分的困扰，他们分别从第20位和第14位起步，但似乎都没有速度能与麦克拉伦的赛事获胜者兰多·诺里斯或红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘在第二位相匹配。
汉密尔顿对天空体育F1说："这对整个团队来说真的是一个艰难的一天和周末。他们做得非常出色。"
"所有的机械师都做得非常出色，他们更换了引擎，并确保汽车尽可能好。"
汉密尔顿有一个很好的起步，他在第一圈就攀升到第九位，并且成功地在赛道在比赛早期变干时成为了第一个从中间胎切换到光头胎的车手，但他没有速度来利用这两个时刻。
基米·安东内利在圣保罗大奖赛的首圈超越兰多·诺里斯取得领先。
他说："我们在干燥的赛道上有些吃力，但我起步很出色。不幸的是，后胎膨胀并过热了，我有些挣扎。
"之后，我努力切换到干胎，最终我做到了，我想我是最早切换到这种轮胎的车手之一。
"我感觉很好。在这种条件下非常棘手。我们最终多停了一次站，这最终让我有很多地要追。"

detailEn: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says he overrode team's pit call due to 'lack of information' provided as rain fell during Sao Paulo GP

Lewis Hamilton finished ninth in the Sao Paulo Grand Prix as Ferrari endured a disappointing weekend in Brazil; Hamilton lost out late in the race after ignoring a call to come into the pits to switch from slick to intermediate tyres as rain intensified
Lewis Hamilton nearly crashes out in the rain before entering the pits on slick tyres.
Lewis Hamilton says a lack of information led to him overriding Ferrari's call for him to come into the pits as rain fell during the closing stages of the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

Hamilton was running in eighth at Interlagos when heavy rain began to fall with 10 laps to go. While the leaders had already passed the pit entry by the time the rain intensified, Mercedes brought in George Russell from fifth.

Ferrari instructed Hamilton to come in, but he decided to do the opposite to the car just in front of him at the time, Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson. Hamilton's team-mate Charles Leclerc, running just behind him, came into the pits.

The seven-time world champion spun on the next lap in the treacherous conditions, before pitting at the end of it to follow his rivals onto intermediates.
Highlights from the 2026 Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

While there was little at stake, as Hamilton ultimately finished ninth rather than claiming what could have been seventh if he had got past Lawson, it was the latest example of imperfect execution from the British driver and his Italia team.
Speaking to Sky Italy after the race, Hamilton said: "The last bit of information I got was that the rain was going to stay the same, and in those conditions my grip was feeling pretty good.
"And I was like, 'ah, I'm catching.' And I was coming out the last corner, just before the pit lane they asked me to box, and I was right behind Lawson.
Following a disappointing race, Lewis Hamilton reflects on 'tough' Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
"He went in, and I ended up staying (out). They didn't say it's raining more in the first half of the lap. If I'd have known that I would have come in.
"As soon as I got to Turn 1, I realised it was wet. So, it just lacked a little bit of information there.
"And ultimately, that's on me. Sorry for the team, for that. I gave it everything. We just didn't have the pace today unfortunately."

Hamilton had come into the weekend off the back of a major controversy with his team-mate in Mexico last weekend, as he was angered by a first-lap clash between the pair that he felt cost him victory and the team a one-two.
While Hamilton revealed on Saturday that the pair had "squashed" their issues, the precious nature of their winning opportunity in Mexico City was highlighted by their struggles in Brazil.
Ferrari Team Principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after a public spat between the two,

Both Hamilton and Leclerc were compromised by grid penalties that saw them start from 20th and 14th, respectively, but neither appeared to have the pace to match McLaren's race winner Lando Norris or Red Bull's Max Verstappen in second.
Hamilton told Sky Sports F1: "Really tough day and weekend for the whole team. They have done a really great job.
"All the mechanics did such a great job switching out the engine and making sure the car was as good as it could be."

Hamilton had a great start as he climbed to ninth on the first lap, and successfully pulled off being the first driver to switch from intermediates to slicks as the track dried early in the race, but didn't have the pace to take advantage of either moment.

He added: "We struggled in the dry but I had a great start. Unfortunately, the rear tyres just ballooned and overheated and I struggled.
"After that, I was pushing to go onto the slicks, which I eventually got on, I think I was one of the earlier ones [to switch to that tyre].
"I was feeling pretty good. It was very tricky in those conditions. We ended up having an extra stop, which ultimately, I had a lot of ground to cover there."

在圣保罗大奖赛第69圈，这位摩纳哥车手正与小红牛车手争夺第七名，两人在12号弯的Juncao弯发生接触，但双方都能继续比赛并完赛。
这次碰撞确实让勒克莱尔从劳森手中夺走了第七名，但该事件被置于调查之下，将在赛后听证会处理。
在询问了两名车手并评估了视频和数据后，国际汽联干事认定勒克莱尔应承担责任，并相应地给予他5秒罚时，使这位法拉利车手在最终成绩中落到对手身后，跌至第八名。
国际汽联干事认可这次接触是轻微的，且发生在湿滑条件下，这足以减轻处罚，使罚时保持在5秒，而非可能面临的10秒处罚。
国际汽联干事判词：“虽然接触轻微，30号车此后得以保持领先，但30号车车手声称接触损坏了他赛车的左后轮辋，并使16号车得以在赛道上更接近他，随后在5个弯后最终超越他。此外，根据驾驶标准指南，30号车拥有该弯角的路权，16号车有责任采取必要措施避免碰撞。”
“16号车车手声称这是一次没有明显体育后果的轻微接触。”
“我们承认接触轻微，但在审查了两车在赛道上的争夺后，我们得出结论：16号车之所以能够更接近并随后超越30号车，正是因为这次接触。接触明显干扰了30号车，使16号车在接触前距离更远的情况下得以并排。这是明显的体育后果。”
“在减轻处罚方面，湿滑条件加上接触的性质（即轻微）已被考虑在内，因此处以5秒罚时而非10秒罚时。”
安东内利和贝尔曼也因维修区不安全放车而受罚
新科F1世界冠军基米·安东内利在巴西大奖赛后也因维修区不安全放车被处以五秒罚时。
这位意大利车手在比赛中最后一次进站时被放行，正好挡在迎面驶来的弗兰科·科拉平托的行车路线上，尽管他试图采取避让措施，但仍被判定为不安全放车，因此被处以五秒罚时。
但由于安东内利领先奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里超过20秒完赛，而皮亚斯特里在赛道上紧随其后，这一罚时并未改变他最终第五名的完赛名次——梅赛德斯也就此锁定了今年的F1车队总冠军。
在另一起同样涉及勒克莱尔的事件中，奥利弗·贝尔曼因在维修区进站时不安全放车而被处以赛后五秒罚时。这位哈斯F1车手被放行时正好挡在法拉利车手的行进路线上，迫使勒克莱尔在维修区减速避让。
这一罚时对贝尔曼同样没有实际影响，因为他以第17名完赛，且领先第18名的塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯一圈。
detailEn: Charles Leclerc penalised for Liam Lawson clash; Kimi Antonelli and Oliver Bearman also punished after F1 Brazilian GP
Charles Leclerc drops from seventh to eighth place in the final F1 Brazilian GP classification due to a post-race penalty
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls
Charles Leclerc was handed a five-second penalty after the Formula 1 Brazilian Grand Prix for his clash with Liam Lawson, dropping the Ferrari driver down to eighth place in the final results.

The Monegasque was battling the Racing Bulls driver for seventh place on lap 69 of the Sao Paulo race when the pair made contact into Juncao, Turn 12, but both were able to continue and finish the race.
The clash did enable Leclerc to take seventh place from Lawson but the incident was placed under investigation for a post-race hearing.

After speaking to both drivers and assessing the video and data, the FIA stewards determined Leclerc was to blame and duly gave him a five-second penalty, dropping the Ferrari driver behind his rival and into eighth place in the final results.
The FIA stewards accepted that the contact was minor and in wet conditions, which was enough mitigation to keep the penalty to 5s and not a potential 10s punishment.

FIA stewards passages: “While the contact was minor and Car 30 was able to maintain the lead thereafter, the driver of Car 30 claimed that the contact damaged the rear left rim of his car and also enabled Car 16 to get closer to him on track and then eventually overtake him 5 corners later. Furthermore, under the Driving Standard Guidelines, Car 30 had the right to the corner and it was for Car 16 to take the necessary steps to avoid a collision.
“The driver of Car 16 claimed that it was a minor contact with no obvious sporting consequence.

“While we acknowledge that the contact was minor, having examined the fight on track between the two cars, we conclude that Car 16 was able to get closer to and thereafter overtake Car 30 because of the contact. The contact clearly disrupted Car 30 and allowed Car 16 to pull up alongside when it was further away before the contact. This was an obvious sporting consequence.
“In mitigation, the wet conditions coupled with the nature of the contact (i.e. minor) was taken into account in imposing a 5 second time penalty as opposed to a 10 second time penalty.”
Antonelli and Bearman also penalised for unsafe releases from pitstops
New F1 world champion Kimi Antonelli was also given a five-second penalty after the Brazilian GP for an unsafe pitstop release.

The Italian was released from his final pitstop of the race into the path of the oncoming Franco Colapinto and despite attempting to take avoiding action it was judged unsafe and a five-second penalty was duly handed out.

But because Antonelli finished over 20s ahead of Oscar Piastri, who was directly behind him on the road, it does not change his final finishing position of fifth place – as Mercedes secured this year’s F1 constructors’ championship.

In a separate incident also involving Leclerc, Oliver Bearman was given a post-race five-second penalty for an unsafe release from a pitstop. The Haas F1 driver was released into the path of the Ferrari driver, which forced Leclerc to check-up in the pitlane.
The penalty has no consequence to Bearman either given he finished in 17th and one lap up on Sergio Perez in 18th place.

keyPointsEn: The contact occurred on lap 69 of the Sao Paulo race at Turn 12, Juncao, while the pair battled for seventh place; both were able to continue and finish the race.

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen "needs to understand what happened" after "night and day" F1 comeback in Brazilian GP
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在巴西大奖赛中的“日夜”F1回归后“需要理解发生了什么”
根据马克斯·维斯塔潘的说法，他在第一圈练习后，他的红牛赛车感觉完全不同。这位荷兰人强调，他非常期待在无网格罚分的情况下在英特拉戈斯赛道进行一场比赛
马克斯·维斯塔潘连续第三年在巴西展现了令人印象深刻的回归表现。虽然他在2024年从第17位发车并最终夺冠，去年从维修区出发冲上领奖台，但维斯塔潘今年在巴西大奖赛中从第21位发车，最终获得了第二名
然而，正如维斯塔潘在赛后新闻发布会上承认的那样，他的起步并不完全按照计划进行
“说实话，我在起步时的反应时间非常慢，因为我没有正确握住离合器。我必须非常迅速地反应，然后起步时速度很慢，所以这是我的错误，”这位四次世界冠军承认道。
“然后在前三个弯道，我运气有点不好，那里交通堵塞，前面有三四辆车基本上阻挡了我超车的空间。实际上，刘易斯的第一圈表现非常好，他真的可以穿过那些车。我有点失望，因为我没有取得同样的进步。”
然而，之后，维斯塔潘像热刀切黄油一样穿过了整个赛道，并很快超过了他在2021年的冠军对手。
但是，在两圈之内，我几乎在每个弯道都飞驰而过，我们的抓地力比中游的大部分车都要好。我不知道我在第几圈进入了前十，但这一切都发生得非常快。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
维斯塔潘继续向领奖台位置发起冲击，甚至似乎有机会赢得胜利。然而，在第一轮维修区停车后，小红牛22不再感觉一样，荷兰人赛后总结道。
“当我换上干胎后，在高速弯道中车辆出现了极端的过度转向，这使得驾驶变得极其困难，”他说。
“我们需要了解是否是车辆上有什么东西坏了，某种气动损失或其他原因，因为这不是正常情况。当然，我很高兴获得第二名，但与此同时，我知道如果车辆状况良好，还有更多的可能性。
“不幸的是，情况并非如此。实际上，我大部分时间都在用一辆状况不佳的赛车完成比赛。”
这就是为什么范斯特appen在爬出赛车后立即检查了车尾，看看是否有任何损坏。
红牛车队在比赛中已经承认，他们从数据中看到了后部下压力的损失，但当时由劳伦特·梅基斯领导的车队还不知道荷兰人可能在哪里或是否受到了损坏。
“但我们必须理解为什么或者赛车在换上湿地胎后出了什么问题，因为即使我在最后换回干地胎，赛车与我的第一次比赛相比也有天壤之别。这表明有问题。”范斯特appen说。
尽管从第21位攀升至第2位仍然是一项令人印象深刻的成就，这也为他赢得了‘当日车手’奖项。在Interlagos的复出驾驶几乎已成为一种传统，但维斯塔潘强调他希望明年能打破这一传统，并理想情况下避免在圣保罗的网格处罚。
"也许明年我会希望从更靠前的位置开始比赛，而不是从后或维修区出发，但明年我们就会知道了，"这位目前排名锦标赛第二位的选手说。
"我喜欢这样的比赛，但明年，让我们试着从更靠前的位置开始，好吗？那将是非常棒的开局。"
detailEn: Max Verstappen "needs to understand what happened" after "night and day" F1 comeback in Brazilian GP

According to Max Verstappen, the balance of his Red Bull car felt completely different after the first stint. The Dutchman stresses that he is very much looking forward to a race at Interlagos without a grid penalty

For the third year in a row, Max Verstappen has produced an impressive comeback drive in Brazil. While he won from 17th on the grid in 2024 and drove from the pitlane to the podium last year, Verstappen finished this year's Formula 1 Brazilian Grand Prix in second place after starting 21st.
His start did not go entirely to plan, however, as Verstappen acknowledged in the post-race press conference:

"To be honest, I had a very slow reaction time off the line because I was holding the clutch wrong. I had to very quickly react and then I was slow off the line, so that was my mistake," the four-time world champion admitted.

"Then I just got a bit unlucky in the first three corners where there was a traffic jam, three or four cars in front basically blocking how much I could pass. Actually, Lewis had a very good first lap, he could really get through those cars. I was a little bit disappointed that I couldn't make the same headway."
After that, however, Verstappen cut through the field like a hot knife through butter and soon managed to overtake his championship rival from 2021 as well.

"But then, within two laps, I was just flying by cars, almost every corner. We had a lot more grip, I guess, than most in the midfield. I don't know what lap I was in the top 10, but it all happened very quickly."
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing

Verstappen then continued his charge towards the podium positions and even appeared to have a potential shot at victory. After the first round of pitstops, however, the RB22 no longer felt the same, the Dutchman concluded post-race.
"As soon as I switched to the slicks, I had an extreme amount of oversteer in the car in the high-speed corners, which made it super difficult to drive," he said.

"We need to understand if something broke on the car, some kind of aero loss or whatever, because this was not normal. I sit here, of course, very happy with second, but at the same time, I know there was more in it if the car had been in good shape.
"Unfortunately, that was not the case. I actually did most of the race with a car that was not in good shape."
That was precisely why Verstappen immediately inspected the rear of his car after climbing out, to see whether there was any damage.

Red Bull had already acknowledged during the race that it could see a loss of rear downforce in the data, but at that point the team led by Laurent Mekies did not yet know whether, or where, the Dutchman might have sustained damage.

"But we have to understand why or what went wrong with the car as soon as we went to the slick tyres, because even when I switched back to the Inter tyres at the end, the car was night and day different to my first stint. That shows that there is something wrong," Verstappen said.

Nevertheless, climbing from 21st to second was still an impressive achievement, which also earned him the Driver of the Day award. Comeback drives at Interlagos have almost become a tradition, but Verstappen stresses that he would like to break that next year and ideally avoid a grid penalty in Sao Paulo.
"Maybe next year I'd love to start a bit further up front instead of starting from the back or the pitlane, but we'll find out next year," the current runner-up in the championship standings said.
"I like races like this, but next year, let's try and just start a bit further up front, please. That would be great to start with."

items.originalTitle: Leclerc loses two points for repeating his 'GP2 move'
detailZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔因为在巴西大奖赛中对利亚姆·劳森的超越而被处罚，裁判取消了那次超车的成绩。
勒克莱尔大部分时间都在前十之外，他起步时排在第14位，但在中雨轮胎的最后一节比赛中表现更加出色，其中包括在最后一圈超越劳森。
那次超车始于勒克莱尔在上一个回合结束时与劳森在Juncao 12号弯顶点发生接触。
两人继续争夺，直到勒克莱尔在Senna S弯出口超越劳森并拉开距离，最终以第七名的成绩冲过终点线。
但是两位车手在比赛后都必须接受裁判组的调查，因为勒克莱尔受到了处罚。
裁判组的裁决中提到：“虽然接触很小，劳森之后也能保持[位置]，但劳森声称接触损坏了他的赛车左后轮圈，并且也使得勒克莱尔有机会在赛道上接近他，并在五圈后最终超越他。”
此外，根据驾驶标准指南，劳森有权进入弯道，勒克莱尔应该采取必要的措施避免碰撞。
勒克莱尔认为这是一次轻微的接触，没有明显的体育后果。
“虽然我们承认接触是轻微的，但通过查看两车在赛道上的战斗，我们得出结论，勒克莱尔能够接近并最终超越劳森是因为这次接触。”
“这次接触显然打乱了劳森的节奏，使得勒克莱尔在接触之前更远的时候就能并排行驶。这是一个明显的体育后果。”
“作为减轻处罚的考虑，由于湿滑的赛道条件以及接触的性质（即轻微），对勒克莱尔处以5秒时间罚分，而不是10秒时间罚分。”
“这次罚分使得勒克莱尔从第七位降至第八位，而劳森则从第八位升至第七位。”
勒克莱尔第九名的法拉利车队队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿被套圈，所以即使受到更大的处罚，勒克莱尔也不会落后于他。
赛后接受媒体采访时，劳森表示他没有时间仔细回顾事故，但他认为“我们真的很幸运”，后果没有更严重。
他甚至说这“就像[勒克莱尔]在阿布扎比的GP2动作一样，就像[亚历克斯]阿隆索九年前那样。
“他做了类似的事情。所以，也许这是他的专长。我不知道这是否合法。我们显然会去审查。但整体来说，这是一场很好的较量。”
在2017年F2锦标赛的决赛轮中，勒克莱尔在阿布扎比短道赛中最后一圈触碰到阿隆索的赛车，并在最后时刻超越他赢得胜利。
在其他地方，有两名车手因不安全发车被处以五秒的罚时。
基米·安东内利因在法科·科拉平托的阿尔皮纳赛车前方发车而被处罚。
裁判组表示，梅赛德斯车队"承认这次发车处理得不够好，也没有采取更安全的方式"。
安东内利的五秒罚时并未改变他第五名的成绩，他以20秒的优势领先奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里完成比赛。
奥利·贝尔曼也因不安全释放而受到罚时，但这并未改变他的位置（第17名）。
detailEn: Charles Leclerc has been penalised for his overtake on Liam Lawson in Formula 1’s Brazilian Grand Prix, with the stewards reversing the result of that pass.

Leclerc spent a lot of the race outside the top 10, having started down in 14th, but he enjoyed a more competitive final stint on the intermediates, which included passing Lawson on the penultimate lap.
That move started with Leclerc making contact with Lawson at the end of the previous lap, at the apex of the Turn 12 Juncao corner.
The duo continued to fight until Leclerc got ahead exiting the Senna S and pulled clear, crossing the line in seventh place.
But both drivers had to see the stewards after the race, with Leclerc penalised.

“While the contact was minor and Lawson was able to maintain the [position] thereafter, Lawson claimed that the contact damaged the rear left rim of his car, and also enabled Leclerc to get closer to him on track and then eventually overtake him five corners later," the stewards' verdict read.
“Furthermore, under the driving standard guidelines, Lawson had the right to the corner and it was for Leclerc to take the necessary steps to avoid a collision.
“Leclerc that it was a minor contact with no obvious sporting consequence.

“While we acknowledge that the contact was minor, having examined the fight on track between the two cars, we conclude that Leclerc was able to get closer to and thereafter overtake Lawson because of the contact.
“The contact clearly disrupted Lawson and allowed Leclerc to pull up alongside when it was further away before the contact. This was an obvious sporting consequence.
“In mitigation, the wet conditions coupled with the nature of the contact (ie minor) was taken into account in imposing a five-second time penalty as opposed to a 10-second time penalty.”
That penalty drops Leclerc from seventh to eighth and promotes Lawson from eighth to seventh.
Leclerc’s ninth-placed Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton was lapped, so Leclerc wouldn’t have dropped behind him, even if a larger penalty was imposed.
When speaking to media after the race Lawson said he hadn't had time to properly review the incident, but he thinks "we got really lucky" the consequences weren't worse.
He even said it was "exactly like [Leclerc's] GP2 move in Abu Dhabi, like on [Alex] Albon [nine] years ago.
"He did the same kind of thing. So, maybe it's his speciality. I don't know if it's legal or not. We'll obviously go and review it. But it was a good battle overall."
In the final round of his dominant 2017 Formula 2 title campaign, Leclerc touched the back of Albon's car before passing him for victory on the final lap of the Abu Dhabi sprint race.
Elsewhere, there was a pair of five-second time penalties for unsafe releases.
Kimi Antonelli was punished for being released into the path of Franco Colapinto's Alpine.
The stewards said Mercedes "acknowledged that this release could have been handled better and in a safer manner".
Antonelli's five-second penalty didn't alter his fifth place finish as he finished 20 seconds clear of Oscar Piastri.
Ollie Bearman also got an unsafe release penalty that didn't change his position (17th).

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli: "Weird" spin and car instability cost F1 Brazilian GP win
items.summaryEn: Antonelli said balance issues and a "weird" spin took him out of contention for the win at the Brazilian Grand Prix, but he still celebrated Mercedes winning the Formula 1 constructors' title.
detailZh: 安东内利："诡异"打滑与赛车不稳致巴西大奖赛失冠
这位2026年世界冠军用半雨胎甩开了诺里斯，但换上干胎后赛车操控异常，局面变得棘手。
安东内利表示，他将放下巴西大奖赛的怒火，转而庆祝梅赛德斯赢得F1车队总冠军，同时他对赛车平衡问题以及导致他退出争冠的那次打滑感到惋惜。
这位新科世界冠军在起步时从杆位得主兰多·诺里斯手中抢下领先，并在比赛初段对这位英国车手建立起相当健康的优势。他在第一次进站前后都保持领先，当时赛道已干到足以使用干胎，尽管诺里斯的提前进站追回了安东内利相当一部分优势。
第20圈开始时，安东内利失控，在开场弯发生打转。他虽能恢复，但诺里斯早已冲过取得领先——这让这位意大利车手落入伊萨克·哈贾尔的纠缠之中。
安东内利在打转前曾报告，他担心悬挂出现问题，赛车在加速时向一侧跑偏——他平衡上的困难又让哈贾尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘夺走了更多位置。然而，比赛中并未出现明确原因。
“我对这场比赛非常失望。说实话我非常愤怒，但我现在要把这一切放在一边，因为车队锁定了总冠军，”安东内利说。
“我们为车队锁定了总冠军，他们所有人都配得上，我非常自豪能成为这个团队的一员，这个团队为我做了并将继续做这么多，我为他们感到非常高兴。但具体谈到这场比赛，是的，非常令人失望。
兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，利亚姆·劳森，小红牛，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
“到那个时刻为止，我们本来有望获胜。而且当时还处在领先位置，一旦轮胎达到温度，我就进入了节奏。但没错，打滑还是发生了，这仍然是我需要查看的问题，因为我也不知道为什么车尾会那么快地失去抓地力。
“就像没有任何预警，什么都没有。但说实话，在我换上软胎时，我就感觉赛车有些奇怪。所以，我们需要检查发生了什么，但另一方面，没错，很遗憾，因为我们就是在那里输掉了比赛。”
在接受天空体育采访时，安东内利详细谈到了这个问题，并指出它只发生在左弯，尤其是在速度更高的路段——而在英特拉格斯，这会涵盖第一和第三赛段的大部分区域。
在打转中造成的轮胎平斑让他的处境艰难得多；当他换上第二套软胎后，圈速的提升是显而易见的，这也为他提供了在后期挑战哈贾尔的机会。
“我们需要检查一下赛车后部的几何结构，因为这个问题只出现在左弯。尤其是在高速时，我感觉最明显，”他告诉天空体育。
“而且车尾感觉非常不稳定，甚至在进入终点线左侧弯道时，车尾也非常松散，这很奇怪。
“我们需要检查赛车上的某些东西，看看是否发生了什么。但那是一种非常奇怪的感觉。然后当我打转时，轮胎已经完了；四个轮子都出现了平斑。只有当我换上第二套轮胎后，我们才恢复了速度。真是太遗憾了。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli: "Weird" spin and car instability cost F1 Brazilian GP win
The 2026 world champion had escaped from Norris on intermediates, but odd handling under the slick-tyre switch proved to be fraught

Kimi Antonelli vowed to put aside his Brazilian Grand Prix anger to celebrate Mercedes winning the Formula 1 constructors' title, as he rued the balance issues and the spin that took him out of victory contention.

The new world champion had picked up the lead from polesitter Lando Norris at the start, and was building a pretty healthy lead over the Briton in the opening laps of the race. He held the lead either side of the first round of pitstops, as the circuit was dry enough for slicks, although Norris' undercut had taken a considerable chunk of time out of Antonelli's advantage.

At the start of lap 20, Antonelli then lost the car and this precipitated a spin at the opening corner. He was able to recover, but Norris had long since bolted past for the lead - and it left the Italian in the clutches of Isack Hadjar.

Antonelli had reported before his spin that he was worried he'd picked up a suspension issue, and that the car was pulling to one side under acceleration - and his difficulty with balance cost further positions to Hadjar and Max Verstappen. However, no clear cause had emerged during the race.
"I'm very disappointed for the race. I'm very angry to be fair, but I'm going to put all this aside for now because the team clinched the title," Antonelli said.

"We clinched the title for the team, and they all deserve it and I'm very proud to be part of this group and this team who has done and still does so much for me and I'm very happy for them. But talking about the race specifically, yeah, very disappointing.
Lando Norris, McLaren, Liam Lawson, Racing Bulls, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

"We were on for the win up to that point. Also in the lead, once I was able to get some temperature I was getting to the rhythm. But yeah, the spin came which still is something I need to look at because I don't know why I lost the rear so quickly as well.

"Like no warning, nothing. But already to be fair when I put the soft, I felt something weird with the car. So, we need to check what happened but on the other hand yeah, shame because we lost the race there."

When speaking to Sky Sports, Antonelli expanded on the issue and noted that it was only occurring in the left-hand corners, particularly in higher-speed sections - which, around Interlagos, would account for much of the first and third sectors.

The tyre flat spots sustained in the spin made his life much harder; when he'd taken a second set of soft tyres, his improvement in lap time was demonstrable and this afforded an opportunity to challenge Hadjar late on.
"We need to check something with the geometry of the car, of the rear, because I had this issue only in left corners. So especially at the high speed was when I was feeling it the most," he told Sky.
"And the rear felt very unstable, even in coming into the finish line in the left kink, the rear was very loose, which was weird.

"We need to check something in the car to see if anything happened. But it was a very odd feeling. And then when I spun, the tyres were gone; all four wheels flat spotted. Only when then I put on the second set, we got back to pace. It was a shame."

items.titleZh: 2026年F1最佳赛事？巴西大奖赛混乱的点评
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1巴西大奖赛的混乱表现引发了众多思考，Scott Mitchell-Malm认为这既是对F1赛事活力的肯定，也是对赛事可能出现的平淡无奇的警告。
items.originalTitle: F1 2026's best race? Our verdict on Brazil chaos
detailZh: 2026年一级方程式最佳赛事？2027年F1的预览？反向发车赛事的模板还是对它们的警示？一场混乱的巴西大奖赛让我们有很多思考。
让我们来看看我们团队对这场比赛的看法...
一旦主要锦标赛早早决出胜负，总会有一种可怕的风险，那就是收官阶段变得非常平淡和缺乏活力，充斥着毫无悬念的比赛。
尤其是当领跑的冠军仍然有实力赢得剩余的比赛时。幸运的是，即使没有（车手）冠军在望，我们仍然有机会看到每场比赛都有强烈的叙事。而且，你总是可以期待Interlagos在赛季中带来一些特别的事情！
今天有什么好不高兴的呢？我记不起有哪场比赛像今天这样充满了精彩瞬间。
比赛开始时的领先权变化，利亚姆·劳森短暂地排在第二位，刘易斯·汉密尔顿荒谬的开局圈，马克斯·维斯塔潘持续而精彩的冲刺至第二位，乔治·罗素在维修区打转（这很少见！），基米·安东内利在领先时失控（然后又失去了领奖台，同样很少见！）……
唯一缺少的就是一场激烈的胜利争夺战。但即使这种失望也因诺里斯展现出的真正高水平的驾驶而得到了缓解，我希望很多人都能欣赏到这种质量。
如果/当一级方程式赛车在阿布扎比比赛时，我会数着圈数，因为我对这个比赛有着极其低落的期望，甚至包括卡塔尔，无论对那些比赛的任何更广泛的讨论。
所以如果赛季陷入低谷，我们总还有巴西...
本可以更好的学期末乐趣
这场比赛有很多值得欣赏的地方，包括其曲折和转折，这一切都得益于Interlagos的赛道布局、赛场的典型天气模式和氛围。一些惊人的超越动作，一些非常奇怪的事件，以及一些惊喜。
但那个并非弱势的杆位车手仍然赢得了比赛。我希望一场开始于小红牛和奥迪在排位赛的前四名、哈斯第六名，以及两名排名最靠后的车（阿斯顿·马丁和威廉姆斯）在前十名中的比赛，没有回到如此‘老一套’的大赢家格局——同时也非常享受维斯塔潘的史诗级进步。
虽然希望进步能带来一些更重要的意义，但想象一下，如果他仍然在与他的精神继承者安东内利争夺冠军的情况下展开这样的场景，即使是法拉利的混乱比赛仍然为车队赢得了一些积分。
总体评价：非常有趣，但遗憾的是没有结果。
这是反对反向排位的完美论据
马特已经找到了为什么对我来说，2026年巴西大奖赛是为什么添加反向排位格式会对F1造成灾难性影响的绝佳证据。
我看到了很多关于这场比赛实际上是一场反向发车实验的引用，维斯塔潘、刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔都站在发车区的错误一端。
观看他们恢复的过程很有趣，但也突显了反向发车会失败的两个原因。
第一个原因是，最终的结果实际上和标准发车区差不多，尤其是在像巴西这样的地方，你可以超车。速度更快的赛车不可避免地会通过。而且，如果你有什么的话，你可能会削弱领先战，因为一辆早些时候穿过车流的车可以简单地拉开距离，而他们的最接近的竞争对手的表现则被后面的慢车所破坏。
第二个问题是新鲜感。我喜欢这场比赛。观看法拉利和维斯塔潘等人在比赛中追回领先，而劳森和尼科·胡肯伯格在前面扮演了明星角色，真是太棒了。
但是你能想象每一场比赛都是这样吗？这种新奇的元素会很快消失，你最初看到它的特殊之处也会完全消失，被彻底拆解吗？
所以，请F1保持这种比赛像它现在这样成为罕见的佳肴，而不是未来的模板。
今年最好的比赛？不是。今年最激动人心的比赛？是的。
多变的天气总是增加了比赛的激情；也许我们应该记住伯尼·埃克尔斯顿关于随机喷水系统的建议……
我在这些多变的条件下站在维修区墙上，所以我可以向你保证，正确阅读天气变化并不容易。
你需要从你的车手那里获得一流的信息，并准备好应对任何情况。你需要准备好在完成第二阶段后立即进站。晚一点，由于速度非常快，晚些时候进站的决定可能会非常容易导致你的车撞上护栏。
诺里斯正在证明他在这种条件下非常出色，维斯塔潘也是如此，还有其他几位车手，但在从干胎胎面切换到湿地胎面然后再回到干胎胎面时保持冷静，同时不犯任何错误，领导比赛并非易事。
作为领头的赛车，意味着你要为其他人树立榜样，因此保持抓地力水平至关重要。
除此之外，一些通常的领跑者从后面起步，又给比赛增添了另一层悬念；也许一些反向排位的比赛不应该被轻易否定...
无论如何，最令人兴奋的部分是看到麦克拉伦、小红牛和法拉利已经明显缩小了与梅赛德斯的差距。在赛季初期的统治性表现之后，无疑帮助安东内利赢得了车手冠军，梅赛德斯赢得了车队冠军，看到前方的竞争如此接近真是太棒了。
我不确定这周末法拉利发生了什么，但正如我们看到的，所有车队从周末到周末都有起伏 - 持续地从赛车中获取最佳表现似乎并不容易！
随着我们进入2026年的黄昏赛事，一切预示着下个赛季的顺利。希望我们能在第一场比赛中看到更加激烈的竞争，整个赛季都保持紧密的战斗；我迫不及待了。
detailEn: Formula 1 2026's best race? A preview for F1 2027? A template for reverse grid races or a cautionary warning against them? A chaotic Brazilian Grand Prix gave us plenty to think about.
Here's what our team thought about the race...
There's always a terrible risk that the run-in ends up being really flat and low energy, with a collection of dead-rubber races, once the main championship is decided early.

That's especially the case when the runaway champion is still a decent contender to win the remaining races. Fortunately, we have a good stab at seeing strong race-by-race narratives even without a (drivers') title on the line. And you can always count on Interlagos to throw up something special in a season!
What was there not to enjoy about today? I can't remember a race that had so much packed into it.

A change of lead at the start, Liam Lawson briefly running second, Lewis Hamilton's absurd opening lap, Max Verstappen's much more sustained and spectacular charge to second, George Russell spinning in the pitlane (that's rare!), Kimi Antonelli chucking it off while leading (then again to lose out on a podium, almost as rare!)...

The only thing it was missing was a close fight for victory. But even that disappointment is tempered by the knowledge that Norris produced a really classy drive that I hope a lot of people can appreciate the quality of.
I'll be counting down the laps if/when F1 races in Abu Dhabi, for I have immensely low hopes for that race, and even Qatar, regardless of any wider debate over those races.
So if the season nosedives into an anti-climax, we'll always have Brazil...
End-of-term fun that could've been even better

There was a lot to enjoy about that race and its twists and turns, all helped by the Interlagos layout, the venue's typical weather pattern and atmosphere. Some amazing overtaking moves, some very weird incidents and quite a few surprises.

But the not-an-underdog polesitter still won it. And I wish a race that started with a Racing Bulls and an Audi in the top four on the grid, a Haas sixth and two of the worst cars on the grid (an Aston Martin and a Williams) in the top 10 hadn't reverted to quite such a 'usual suspects' sweep of the major positions - while also really enjoying Verstappen's epic progress in particular.

Wish that progress had counted for something a bit more significant, though. Imagine that scenario unfolding with him still in a title fight with, say, his spiritual successor Antonelli. Even Ferrari's chaotic mess of a race still earned it a few points.
Overall verdict: very entertaining, sadly inconsequential.
The perfect argument against reverse grids
Matt has hit upon why, for me, the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix is great evidence of why adding a reverse grid format would be terrible for F1.
I saw plenty of references to this race essentially being a reverse grid experiment with Verstappen, Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc all at the wrong end of the grid.
While it was entertaining to watch them recover, it highlighted why reverse grids would fail for two reasons.

Number one is that you actually end up with a similar result anyway to a standard grid, especially at somewhere like Brazil, where you can overtake. The faster cars are inevitably going to come through. And if anything you can end up diluting the lead battle, because one car that gets through the traffic earlier, can simply pull away while their closest rival performance is marred behind slower cars.

And the second problem is the novelty factor. I loved this race. Watching the likes of the Ferraris and Verstappen battle back through, while the likes of Lawson and Nico Hulkenberg got starring roles at the front, was brilliant.
But can you imagine that every race? How quickly that novelty factor would wear off and you lose the very reason it's so special to see it in the first place, be completely dismantled?
So please F1. Keep this kind of race the rare treat that it is, not the template for the future.
Hope for 2027!
Best race of the year? No. Most exciting race of the year? Yes.
Changeable weather always adds to the excitement; perhaps we should remember Bernie Ecclestone’s suggestion of a random sprinkler system……
I have been there on the pitwall in these changeable conditions, so I can assure you reading the weather changes correctly is not easy.

You need first-rate information from your driver and to be ready for anything. You need to be ready to pit as you finish sector two really. Any later, and as it’s so fast, a late call into the pits can very easily end up with your car in the barrier.

Norris is proving that he is brilliant in these conditions, as is Verstappen, plus a few others, but keeping cool when going from inters to slicks and then back to inters without making any mistakes whilst leading is no easy task.
Being the lead car means you are setting the example for the others, so driving within the grip level is critical.
To add to that, having a few of the usual frontrunners starting at the back just gave it another twist; again, perhaps a few reverse grid races shouldn’t be dismissed out of hand...

Anyway, the best part of it is seeing that McLaren, Red Bull and Ferrari have definitely closed the gap to Mercedes. After such a dominant start to the season, which without doubt helped Antonelli win the drivers' championship and Mercedes win the constructors' championship, it’s great to see much closer competition at the front.

I'm not sure what happened to Ferrari this weekend, but as we see with all the teams from weekend to weekend, they have their ups and downs - consistently getting the best from the car doesn’t seem to be easy!

As we head into the twilight races of 2026, it all bodes well for next season. Hopefully, we will see much closer competition from the first race and close battling right through the season; I can’t wait.

他写道：“我要向梅赛德斯一级方程式车队的每一位成员致以最热烈的祝贺，祝贺你们成为2026年车队世界冠军。登上F1的巅峰从来都不是一个人的成就。”
“这是非凡天赋、不懈决心以及数百人共同信念的结果——无论是在赛道上还是在工厂里，所有人都被同一个雄心所凝聚。这支车队的每一位成员都应当为自己所取得的成就感到无比自豪。”
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯；安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯；托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
不过，他确实有话要对沃尔夫说——沃尔夫在2014年至2021年率队连续八次夺冠后，如今已带领梅赛德斯拿下九个冠军头衔。
多梅尼卡利补充道：“这也是一个将在我们这项运动历史上占据特殊位置的时刻。”
“凭借他的第九个车队总冠军，我的朋友托托·沃尔夫追平了伟大的弗兰克·威廉姆斯爵士——F1 真正的传奇人物之一。能在纪录册上与弗兰克并肩，是一项非凡的成就，也有力地证明了托托多年来展现出的领导力、远见以及对卓越的不懈追求。”
梅赛德斯夺得车队总冠军的一周前，安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛上锁定了他首个车手总冠军，成为该系列赛历史上最年轻的总冠军。
这位 F1 首席执行官继续说道：“在基米·安东内利成为史上最年轻车手世界冠军的同一个赛季赢得车队总冠军，让 2026 年对梅赛德斯和 F1 而言都真正令人难忘。”
“这就是我们这项运动的全部意义所在：怀揣远大梦想，突破极限，并证明当优秀的人们为了一个共同的目标团结在一起时，一切皆有可能。梅赛德斯已经重返巅峰，并由此在F1的历史上写下了又一个非凡的篇章。”
在还剩三站比赛的情况下，法拉利以512分位列车队积分榜第二，红牛以415分排名第三。
detailEn: F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali sends heartfelt message to Mercedes after constructors' title victory
Formula 1 CEO Stefano Domenicali has congratulated Mercedes on its 2026 constructors' championship victory
Stefano Domenicali, CEO of the Formula One Group
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Formula 1 CEO Stefano Domenicali has congratulated Mercedes on winning the 2026 constructors' championship while singling out team principal Toto Wolff for joining Sir Frank Williams in the record books.

The Brackley outfit clinched the title with three races to spare at the Brazilian Grand Prix when George Russell and Kimi Antonelli finished fourth and fifth, leaving Ferrari, which currently sits second in the standings, with no way of catching them.
Mercedes has dominated the 2026 season with 12 grand prix wins and four sprint victories between its two drivers.
In a statement, Domenicali was keen to share the credit around the whole team.

"My huge congratulations to everyone at the Mercedes Formula 1 Team on becoming 2026 constructors’ world champions," he wrote. "Reaching the summit of Formula 1 is never the achievement of one person alone.

"It is the result of extraordinary talent, relentless determination and the shared belief of hundreds of people, at the circuit and back at the factory, all united by the same ambition. Every single member of this team should feel incredibly proud of what they have achieved."
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
He did, however, have a message for Wolff, who has now led Mercedes to nine titles after its run of eight in a row from 2014 to 2021.
"This is also a moment that will have a special place in the history of our sport," Domenicali added.

"With his ninth constructors’ title, my friend Toto Wolff draws level with the great Sir Frank Williams, one of Formula 1’s true legends. To stand alongside Frank in the record books is an extraordinary achievement and a powerful testament to Toto’s leadership, vision and relentless pursuit of excellence over so many years."
Mercedes' constructors' title comes one week after Antonelli clinched his maiden drivers' championship at the Mexican Grand Prix, becoming the youngest champion in the history of the series.

"To win the constructors’ championship in the same season that Kimi Antonelli became the youngest ever drivers’ world champion makes 2026 truly unforgettable for Mercedes and for Formula 1," the F1 CEO continued.

"This is what our sport is all about: dreaming big, pushing beyond the limits, and proving what is possible when great people come together with one shared purpose. Mercedes have returned to the very top, and in doing so have written another remarkable chapter in the history of Formula 1."
With three rounds remaining, Ferrari is second in the constructors' standings with 512 points, and Red Bull is third with 415.

detailZh: 安东内利与勒克莱尔在F1巴西大奖赛后接受赛会干事传唤
安东内利和梅赛德斯因涉嫌不安全放车被传唤，勒克莱尔和劳森则必须解释他们在巴西大奖赛比赛尾声的接触
在兰多·诺里斯令人信服地赢下F1巴西大奖赛后，仍有数名车手需要在赛后前往赛会干事处。
安东内利与一名梅赛德斯代表被要求在当地时间下午4点30分到场，事由为涉嫌不安全放车。梅赛德斯放行安东内利时，阿尔派车手弗朗哥·科拉平托正接近，这意味着这位阿根廷车手也必须说明自己的说法。
即使安东内利被罚10秒，也不会影响他的最终名次。这位F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军领先奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里超过20秒，这意味着他的第五名看起来是安全的。
然而，这位意大利车手在英特拉格斯确实经历了一场艰难的比赛，比赛开始前他在前往发车格的路上冲出赛道。比赛中第一弯又出现了几次状况，之后安东内利告诉比赛工程师彼得·邦宁顿赛车“有问题”。不过当时梅赛德斯主要还是在关注安东内利用光头胎时的轮胎温度。
尽管比赛艰难，梅赛德斯还是锁定了车队总冠军，这是该车队的第九个车队总冠军头衔。
冠军在巴西站决出，部分原因是法拉利度过了一个非常艰难的周日，而理论上，这支车队的情况还可能变得更糟。
夏尔·勒克莱尔也被传唤至赛会干事处，他面临的是可能引发碰撞的指控。该事件发生在比赛尾声阶段，当时勒克莱尔在上坡起终点直道前与利亚姆·劳森发生了接触。
赛后在冷却室中，马克斯·维斯塔潘将这一事件描述为“摩擦是赛车的一部分”，但赛会干事认为有必要对此事进一步调查。
如果勒克莱尔受到处罚，对他而言后果将比安东内利更为严重。即便是五秒罚时，也会让他跌至小红牛车手之后，因为两人完赛时的差距仅为1.816秒。
最后，奥利弗·贝尔曼和哈斯车队还必须就一次不安全放车向赛会干事作出解释——巧合的是，此事同样涉及勒克莱尔——尽管这位法拉利青训车手代表美国车队参赛，最终以第17名完赛，早已远离积分区。
本周末的干事小组由尼什·谢蒂、洛伊克·巴克莱纳、维坦托尼奥·柳齐和费利佩·马卢组成。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli and Charles Leclerc summoned to stewards after F1 Brazilian GP
Kimi Antonelli and Mercedes have been summoned over an alleged unsafe release, while Charles Leclerc and Liam Lawson must explain their contact at the end of the Brazilian GP race
Following the Formula 1 Brazilian Grand Prix, which was convincingly won by outgoing world champion Lando Norris, several drivers still have to pay a visit to the stewards post-race.

Kimi Antonelli and a Mercedes representative were required to appear before the stewards at 4.30pm local time over an alleged unsafe release. Mercedes released Antonelli just as Alpine driver Franco Colapinto was approaching, meaning the Argentine also has to give his side of the story.

Even if Antonelli receives a 10-second penalty, it will not affect his finishing position. The youngest world champion in F1 history has a margin of more than 20 seconds over Oscar Piastri, meaning his fifth place appears safe.

The Italian did endure a difficult race at Interlagos, however, which began with an excursion off the track on his way to the grid. Several more moments followed at Turn 1 during the race, after which Antonelli told race engineer Peter Bonnington that there was 'something wrong' with the car. At that point, however, Mercedes was still primarily looking at Antonelli’s tyre temperatures on slicks.
Despite the difficult race, Mercedes has secured the constructors' championship, the team's ninth constructors’ title.
The fact that the title was decided in Brazil is partly down to a very difficult Sunday for Ferrari, and things could theoretically get even worse for the Scuderia.

Charles Leclerc has also been summoned to the stewards, in his case for potentially causing a collision. The incident occurred in the closing stages of the race, when Leclerc made contact with Liam Lawson just before the uphill start-finish straight.
In the cooldown room after the race, Max Verstappen described the incident as “rubbing is racing”, but the stewards consider it necessary to investigate the matter further.

Should Leclerc receive a penalty, it would have greater consequences for him than for Antonelli. Even a five-second penalty would drop him behind the Racing Bulls driver, as the gap between the two at the finish was just 1.816 seconds.

Finally, Oliver Bearman and Haas also have to answer to the stewards over an unsafe release – incidentally, also involving Leclerc – although the Ferrari junior, driving for the American team, finished 17th and was already well outside the points anyway.
The stewards' panel this weekend consists of Nish Shetty, Loïc Bacquelaine, Vitantonio Liuzzi and Felipe Maluh.
